using RecursiveAI.OneEcma;

namespace Demo
{
    /// <summary>Installs every <c>[JsExport]</c> type of this assembly into a realm.</summary>
    public static class JsExports
    {
        /// <summary>Installs all exported types, so scripts see their classes and enums as globals and <see cref="JsRealm.Wrap"/> knows their instances.</summary>
        /// <param name="realm">The realm.</param>
        public static void InstallAll(JsRealm realm)
        {
            realm.Install(global::Demo.AJsBinding.JsType);
            realm.Install(global::Demo.BJsBinding.JsType);
        }

        /// <summary>The script names of the exported types, in install order.</summary>
        public static readonly string[] Names = ["A", "B"];
    }
}
